market_definition: Thermal Interface Materials comprises materials placed between heat-generating components and heat sinks or other thermal pathways to reduce interfacial thermal resistance. The scope includes gap fillers, pads, greases, phase-change materials, thermal adhesives and related interface formats. By Product Type • Thermal Pads • Gap Fillers • Thermal Greases • Phase-Change Materials • Thermal Adhesives • Thermal Putty By Material Chemistry • Silicone-Based • Silicone-Free • Acrylic-Based • Epoxy-Based • Metal / Carbon-Based By Form • Pad / Sheet • Paste / Grease • Dispensable Gel • Film By Performance • Low Thermal Resistance • Electrical Insulation • Electrically Conductive • Low Outgassing By End Use • Consumer Electronics • Data Centers • Automotive Electronics • Telecommunications • Industrial Equipment By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Bulk thermal insulation, heat sinks, fans, liquid-cooling systems, and thermally conductive materials not designed for interface use. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
